nodes.name: Classify Failure Stage
nodes.notes:
MAINTENANCE RULE:
This classifier uses exact main-workflow node names.

If a relevant main-workflow node is renamed, removed, replaced, or newly inserted around the Gmail boundary, review and update beforeGmailNodes, atGmailNodes, and afterGmailNodes before publishing.

Any unrecognized node must remain UNKNOWN until the exact-name map is intentionally updated.

Do not use fuzzy name matching or error-message text to infer the workflow stage.
